{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Overloaded Cycle 1 Day 1 visit",
      "quote": "Treatment Cycle 1a (Day 1) | 2 (Day 1) | 3 (Day 1) | 4+ (Day 1)",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Cycle 1 Day 1 includes a large number of procedures (physical exam, vital signs, labs, PROs, pain, etc.) in addition to treatment administration, which may be burdensome for patients and sites.",
      "fix": "Consider moving some assessments (e.g., PROs) to a separate visit or reducing frequency."
    },
    {
      "title": "ECG only at screening",
      "quote": "ECG | X |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "ECG is only performed at screening, but the protocol text (Section 8.2.3.2) describes ECG procedures without specifying frequency; this may be insufficient for cardiac safety monitoring, especially with docetaxel.",
      "fix": "Add ECGs at key timepoints (e.g., end of treatment) or clarify rationale for single assessment."
    },
    {
      "title": "Coagulation only at screening and SFU",
      "quote": "Coagulation | X |  |  |  |  | X |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Coagulation is only assessed at screening and safety follow-up, but docetaxel can cause bleeding disorders; more frequent monitoring may be needed.",
      "fix": "Add coagulation at least once during treatment or justify based on risk."
    },
    {
      "title": "CT/MRI only at screening",
      "quote": "CT/MRIf | X |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "Disease assessments (CT/MRI) are only listed at screening, but efficacy evaluations are essential for an oncology trial; this is likely an error.",
      "fix": "Add tumor assessments at specified intervals (e.g., every 6-8 weeks) and at end of treatment."
    },
    {
      "title": "PRO-CTCAE not specified in text",
      "quote": "PRO-CTCAE will be administered to all subjects, and collected as indicated in the Schedule of Activities",
      "page": 88,
      "section": "8.2.2.1.3 Clinical Outcome Assessments",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The text mentions PRO-CTCAE but the Schedule of Activities lists 'PRO/QOL assessments: FACT-G GP5 and PRO- CTCAE' as a combined row; this may cause confusion about which instrument is used.",
      "fix": "Clarify in the schedule whether PRO-CTCAE is separate or combined with FACT-G GP5."
    },
    {
      "title": "PGIC only at Cycle 3",
      "quote": "PRO/QOL assessments: PGIC |  |  |  | X |  |  |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "PGIC (Patient Global Impression of Change) is only at Cycle 3 Day 1, but it is typically assessed at multiple post-baseline timepoints to track change over time.",
      "fix": "Consider adding PGIC at later cycles or end of treatment."
    },
    {
      "title": "PGIS missing at Cycle 2",
      "quote": "PRO/QOL assessments: PGIS | X | X |  | X |  |  |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "PGIS is collected at screening, Cycle 1, Cycle 3, but not Cycle 2, which creates an inconsistent pattern for a severity measure.",
      "fix": "Add PGIS at Cycle 2 or justify the gap."
    },
    {
      "title": "Vital Assessments at LTFU only",
      "quote": "Vital Assessments |  |  |  |  |  |  | X",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The row 'Vital Assessments' appears only at LTFU, which is unclear and likely a typo; vital signs are already collected at other visits.",
      "fix": "Remove this row or clarify what 'Vital Assessments' means."
    }
  ]
}
